purpose: Deterministic filter order for building a compact context packet for a single workflow step. Apply filters top-to-bottom BEFORE any semantic similarity.

contextPacket.candidatePatterns: included only when labelled 'candidate' and never applied as authoritative
contextPacket.rawToolOutput: summarized/projected before entering context; full output preserved as an artifact under runs/

routes.note: Concrete record paths live in the routing table to avoid duplication.
